svg.aria-label: TrustLens: contract safety, decoded. The same USDC address scored DANGEROUS 71 by a raw scanner and CAUTION 25 by TrustLens, which follows the proxy to the real code.
svg.title: TrustLens
svg.desc: Two verdict cards for one address. A raw scanner returns DANGEROUS at 71 out of 100 with every flag looking urgent. TrustLens follows the proxy to the implementation and returns CAUTION at 25, noting the admin can upgrade it.
